notes.title: Shards of Her - DEVLog May
notes.content:
Here we go with another DEVLog!

Besides the story content, there will be some new features, and the new Options Menu will be available, plus a few more things. I'm also working on the [b]Interface Language[/b] to be fully functional by the time the next update is released. There is a lot to handle, so I can't give an ETA, but I'm working on it daily alongside the story.

Now, let's focus on the main things that will change or be added in the next update. First off, as I said, the new [b]Options Menu[/b] will be available, fully structured and with options for you. More options will be added, especially in the Accessibility tab. Now, let's take a quick peek at it. I censored [b]Aya[/b] because of the preview; don't worry, she's not censored in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/e24f80d77d789b9efde8316bfefc66f1cf4f67d4.png[/img]

As you can see, we have a new, tabbed, and well-organized UI. Below, I'll present what options can be found in each of the tabs.

[b]DISPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Display Mode - FullScreen / Cinematic
[*] Cinematic Mode - Toggle On/Off
[*] Textbox Opacity - Slider
[*] Text Size - Slider
[/list]
[b]SOUND[/b]
[list]
[*] Music Volume - Slider
[*] Sound Volume - Slider
[*] Voice Volume - Voice Test plus Slider
[*] Mute All Toggle Button
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Unseen Text - Toggle 
[*] After Choices - Toggle
[*] Rollback Side - Left / Right
[*] Text Speed - Slider
[*] Auto-Play Speed - Slider
[/list]
[b]LANGUAGE [/b]
[list]
[*] Interface Language - English / Italian / Chinese / Spanish / German / Russian / Romanian / French
[*] Game Dialogue - TBA
[/list]
The Accessibility tab is a work in progress, as there will be some other options like High Contrast and Subtitles settings, but this is subject to change.

Now, I've added [b]Cinematic Mode[/b] to the game, which can be toggled ON/OFF at any time. It does exactly what you expect, and I've tried to make the experience a bit more cinematic. Below, you can find a comparison between the default and cinematic modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/bdce3b0330a887c376f2ad877a8ce8f949c5e186.png[/img]

Now, for some technical things you may not care about: since I'm working on the Interface Language, about 80% of the code for the [b]Characters[/b], [b]The Shards[/b], and [b]Timeline[/b] sections needs to be changed. This is necessary so I can easily translate everything. It sounds harsher than it is, but I'll deal with it and make sure it's ready for the next release.

[h2]"[i]What if the greatest warning came from the ghost of your own future?[/i]"[/h2]

Regarding the in-game UI Menu, it has been changed to maintain a consistent style throughout. You might have noticed a mix of styles in some areas previously; this will no longer be the case, as a single style is now applied everywhere. Furthermore, each instance where a choice needs to be made will be treated separately to ensure excellent readability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a1219dc0c347e3e009c097c906f469a4fdb764ea.png[/img]
As you can see here, this is the style of the new menu choices. While it looks raw now, I'm testing different things to make it "pop" more for readability, which is why it's currently blending into the background.

Below, you can find the changelog for the upcoming release so far.

SOH Patch 0.4.6/8

[list]
[*] ACT IV Story Content
[*] NEW Memory 15 in the Memories Menu (Needs to be unlocked)
[*] Added CINEMATIC MODE (Toggle from Options)
[*] NEW Options Menu
[*] Smoothed the Narrator VO
[*] UI Remade for Choices Screen
[*] ACT III Script Fixes
[*] Visual Fixes (Overall) and UI Assets
[*] Small Flags Fixes
[/list]

And let's wrap it up with a small preview for now, keeping the rest for the June DEVLog! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/4f164886779962b90479659bcde812750142dfea.png[/img]

[h2]"[i]He pleaded with his past, a desperate echo trying to rewrite a song already sung in sorrow.[/i]"[/h2]

notes.title: Shards of Her - 0.4.4 The Tempest
notes.content:
Hey there, 

So, [b]Shards of Her 0.4.4 The Tempest[/b] update is here, featuring new story content and updates to the previous ACTs. There are improvements across the entire game, including writing, visuals, and audio. 

While there is still much work to be done, I wanted to release this update now as it offers an overall enhancement to the game in all aspects.

[i][h2]"They survived one Dawn, hoping for peace... They should have prayed the dawn never came again." - Aethra[/h2][/i]

There are new characters entering the scene, with more to come. Some characters are also leaving the scene, as the game world is quite dangerous, and lately, whispers can be heard once again.

[b]STORY & LORE[/b] - Bits and pieces were rewritten throughout the entire game to fix some story inconsistencies or simply rewritten for better flow. New lore details have been added, both in-game and in the [b]Characters[/b] menu. So, make sure you check it out! In some cases, certain characters will have their full backstory included in the biography on their [b]Characters[/b] page. So far, there are two such characters; you'll discover them as you play the latest update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8a8d5ca163221de189d5cfe468a742050ba747a7.png[/img]
[b]VISUALS[/b] - This is an ongoing work. The Prologue scene has been improved, and where possible, the quality of the renders was enhanced or they were re-rendered. I'm striving to achieve a cinematic level with each shot and to deliver the best possible experience, both visually and story-wise. [i]Visually and in terms of writing, the entire game will be upgraded as we progress.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a9dc5ea3ad0f7225ea45ddf16496facbe0950eaf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/76ad2e9e5718afde853c066a914f82acee1ea5b7.jpg[/img]

[b]UI[/b] - The [b]Main Menu[/b] of the game has been slightly changed. The animated buttons are not final, and regarding them, please let me know if you experience any performance issues, such as menu lag or other similar problems. The [b]Options[/b] menu is also undergoing some changes, and the Fragments menu (previously Extras) is not final at all. I have other plans for it in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/4cf934703ed5c0fa36e8ce4932a83fde553fa872.png[/img]
As you can see, a new small menu has appeared [b]TOGGLE PERSISTENT VALUES[/b], this menu will be used temporarily for the next few updates. If you load your last saved game and don't receive all the unlockables in the [b]CODEX Menu[/b], you can use this new menu to manually set the missing items to [b]TRUE[/b] or [b]FALSE[/b]. Please note that these values only cover content up to the latest build, as in this version, you need to unlock everything manually through gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/cb525b6ec78b0c360f7109da4f09d968bf1c1acd.png[/img]

The [b]MEMORIES[/b] menu has also been updated with an introduction and a new UI. Lastly, there's the new [b]CODEX Menu[/b]. While the UI for this menu is still being worked on, we'll discuss it further below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/04a096e40ff298226b839370d315742545601d9d.png[/img]
[b]AUDIO[/b] - New music has been added. I didn't have the chance to update the music in the older ACTs for this release, but that will be done in the future to enhance the experience – though not necessarily with drastically different music than before. Additionally, the narration at important points in the game is now voiced over by a dear friend, and I truly appreciate the time she dedicated to this. More characters will have voice acting in future updates; I'm currently working on that.

Now, the STEAM Page was updated with the new features and each one explained, not really necessary to write it here too, what wasn't covered in the Store Page it was in the previous DEVLogs and on this post, I hope I did not forget anything! Let's roll up with the final patch notes for this update. 

[b]SOH 0.4.4 The Tempest Update[/b]

[*] Engine Updated
[*] ACT IV Story Content
[*] Voice Overs for Narration
[*] Script/Dialogue/Visual Fixes (Overall)
[*] Story Fixes (Story Inconsistencies)
[*] New Animations
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Intro Screens for ACTs
[*] Game Conditions Updated
[*] Notifications for Codex Entries Added (Overall)
[*] *Persistent Data Values for Characters/Shards/Timeline & Realms
[*] Added Skip Intro Option
[*] NEW UI for Memories
[*] In-Work UI for Options

[b]PROLOGUE - Veil of Illusion[/b]

[*] Visual Enhancements
[*] Small Dialogue and Narration Changes 

[b]ACT I - Awakening[/b]

[*] Visual Enhancements
[*] Dialogue Fixes & Spellchecking
[*] New Scenes Added
[*] Small UI Changes
[*] NEW Character Introduced

[b]ACT II - Echoes[/b]

[*] Smoothed Transitions
[*] Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
[*] Visual Enhancements & Fixes
[*] Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
[*] New Small Scene Added (Nakata & MC Scene)

[b]ACT III - Reckoning[/b]

[*] Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
[*] Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
[*] Smoothed Transitions

*[b]Persistent Data Values for Characters/Shards/Timeline & Realms[/b] - Due to the new persistent data update, when you load a save game from a version prior to 0.4.4, the game will attempt to unlock content in the [b]CODEX Menu[/b] based on your previous progress. However, if you know you experienced something in an older playthrough that didn't unlock in the [b]CODEX Menu[/b], you can use the [b]TOGGLE PERSISTENT VALUES[/b] option in the [b]Main Menu[/b] to manually unlock everything up to the 0.3.6 build.

NEW Codex Menu

[list]
[*] [b]CHARACTERS[/b] - Explore the lives and legends of those who shape the destiny of this world. Uncover their pasts, their powers, and explore their evolving forms.
[*] [b]REALMS[/b] - Explore the realms touched by both divine grace and primordial darkness. Uncover their forgotten lore, and prepare to walk their paths once more.
[*] [b]THE SHARDS[/b] - Delve into the mysteries of the Seven Shards, remnants of a shattered goddess. Learn their histories, their powers, and the sins they embody.
[*] [b]ASTROLOGY[/b] - Decipher the language of the stars. Explore the months and signs that guide the fate of this world, and discover the hidden connections between the heavens and the earth.
[*] [b]TIMELINE[/b] - From the whispers of creation to the clash of destinies, witness the turning points that defined a universe. Uncover the truth behind the legends, one event at a time.
[/list]

*[i]New features and content will be added to the CODEX Menu in future updates (TBD/TBA).[/i]
*[i]FRAGMENTS Menu will go through some updates in future.[/i]

[i][h2]The echoes of sorrow have been heard.
This act of [b]Remembrance[/b] reveals the price of the past.
Now... the [b]Reaper[/b] comes to collect.[/h2][/i]

[previewyoutube=yVznKcmLmXo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Shards of Her - DEVLog April & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Here we go with another DEVLog, probably the last one before the release of the next update. I'm taking my time to set everything up right and make it seamless for the next ones. I know it takes some time, but I'm trying to deliver a flawless story out there and provide a great experience for everyone.

Now, let's delve into this, and let me present a few things to you, starting from the Prologue up to ACT IV, highlighting the changes and the additional stuff.

[h3][b]PROLOGUE - Veil of Illusion[/b][/h3]

Some minor changes were made to the dialogue and its visuals. The narrator of the Prologue has been changed, and later in ACT IV we'll find out who it is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/df3d1dede39ebc57f692e3276b782197801134f2.png[/img]
[b]Hemera[/b] also received some visual updates, reflecting her [i]status[/i] back then. Now, later... well, we all know how the story turns out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/27d74f4a9727b612248c9bb364be3955c883333f.png[/img]
There are some other changes planned for the Prologue, but those aren't meant to be shown just yet, and they'll only be unlocked after a specific point in the story.

[h3][b]ACT I - Awakening[/b][/h3]

Now, some story inconsistencies have been fixed, dialogue has been rewritten in some cases, and spellchecks have been done overall. Plus, there are visual changes in some instances, and a new character is introduced towards the end of the ACT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/0686459275aeb7220d7fdf43c64e0c429da782d0.png[/img]
A new scene has been introduced before [b]MC[/b] heads to [b]Omikami's Hideout[/b]. This character will appear again later in the game, but with a catch. So, right now the scene doesn't hold important meaning for the story, but it will later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8a8d5ca163221de189d5cfe468a742050ba747a7.png[/img]
The vision scene between [b]Aethra[/b] and [b]Dies[/b] has been enhanced, and their conversation has been improved as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/5a7f3157f60566c4ca29f09e89d252ac6b34bbf9.png[/img]
Now, towards the end of ACT I, during the narration of a version of [b]War of Shadow[/b], we're introduced to a new character. The whole scene is tied to ACT IV, so I won't say more to avoid spoilers.

[h3][b]ACT II - Echoes[/b][/h3]

Visually speaking, this ACT wasn't touched much because I already kind of like how it is. However, some changes will be made to it later, especially when [b]MC[/b] wakes up and has to choose between calling for [b]Hemera[/b] or [b]Omikami[/b], but that's on the TBD list for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/236a957f05d34c3769aad97fa86b08685442bd40.png[/img]
The vision scene has been visually enhanced for both [b]Aethra[/b] and [b]MC[/b].

[h3][b]ACT III - Reckoning[/b][/h3]

This ACT ends, and now we're in the next phase where things are finally starting to get serious, story-wise. Everything starts to connect, linking past, present, and future events, and we finally find out the full story behind [b]Echo[/b]'s actions and how she was [i]time[/i] itself for a while...

New characters make their appearance, and some leave the scene... it's all starting to connect. And the consequences of past events will start to feel [i]real[/i]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/de46ddfeb3b12f853ce442578e94b63b5fe3576a.png[/img]
And now, we'll delve into ACT IV... it's up to you to discover what's happening and where the story is going...

Now, regarding the other changes I mentioned before, starting from ACT IV, whenever you discover new things, meet new characters, find new Shards... or when something major happens, they will be added to the [b]CODEX Menu[/b]. Let's go over it.

The Shards menu got a little overdone since the last design. I wanted to fully animate the buttons, but even with only two of them unlocked, it started to lag. I guess it's due to the engine, so I left them as static images, but you'll get an animated version of each once you open its page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8365d5c09a8a07f838de866a00d9c1bfe38688fc.png[/img]
I don't necessarily consider this a spoiler, but right now two Shards can be found. The rest... well, that's up to you to find. One of them has been in plain sight since the start of the game

As you can see, the page will hold all of the Shards. Each one, as already stated in the game, is based on one of the seven sins and has its own story behind it, explained once you open its page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/68627d2468c12dc42795598c1e8fbb9ef739678b.png[/img]
If you've paid attention to the story, you'll notice how each Shard is somehow tied to its current holder, or whoever found it. And how it affected them, or whether it did at all, depends.

Regarding the Timeline, whenever something major happens or has happened and you've just found some new information about it, it'll get updated. For example, the [b]Shards of Her[/b] event on the current timeline will be updated in [b]ACT IV[/b] because of the things you find out.

And each ACT has its own page which will hold the major events that happened. If an event is too big, it'll have its own section apart from the ACT's own page. As you can see below, we have the section for [b]ACT I - Awakening[/b] fully updated. This page, with all that information, only updates once you've finished ACT I; otherwise, you get the initial description without the details of what happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/79cd9eecaa15ae92e0c3ae461fcfc0037584b15f.png[/img]
You can scroll or drag through it to see everything that has happened as we continue forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/61960699139c0fcafe815f38e666e46bcf762c47.png[/img]
As you can see in this image, in the upper right corner, a notification pops up whenever something new is updated or added to the [b]CODEX Menu[/b], so you'll always know. You can check it for more lore information about whatever it is. In the image above, we have the default entry for [b]ACT I - Awakening[/b] in the [b]Timeline[/b] section of the [b]CODEX Menu[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/6e68d10cc0e50cdb3881c574c17ade223275965e.png[/img]
[h3]"[i]They survived one Dawn, hoping for peace... They should have prayed the dawn never came again.[/i]"[/h3]

The same goes for whenever you meet a new character, find another Shard, or discover a new location; each one comes with its own story.

The STEAM page for the game will be updated once the release is complete and live.

Now, here are the patch notes so far...

[list]
[*] ACT IV Story Content
[*] Voice Overs for Narration (On-Going)
[*] Script/Dialogue/Visual Fixes (Overall)
[*] Story Fixes (Story Inconsistencies)
[*] New Animations
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Intro Screens for ACTs
[*] Game Conditions Updated
[*] Notifications for Codex Entries Added (Overall)
[*] *Persistent Data Values for Characters/Shards/Timeline & Realms
[/list]

PROLOGUE - Veil of Illusion

[list]
[*] Visual Enhancements
[*] Small Dialogue and Narration Changes 
[/list]

ACT I - Awakening

[list]
[*] Visual Enhancements
[*] Dialogue Fixes & Spellchecking
[*] New Scenes Added
[*] Small UI Changes
[*] NEW Character Introduced
[/list]

ACT II - Echoes

[list]
[*] Smoothed Transitions
[*] Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
[*] Visual Enhancements & Fixes
[*] Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
[*] New Small Scene Added (Nakata & MC Scene)
[/list]

ACT III - Reckoning

[list]
[*] Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
[*] Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
[*] Smoothed Transitions
[/list]

* For the moment, this will only be available from the end of ACT III onwards.

I'm sure once again I might have forgotten something to add or reveal, but I'm sure you'll find out once you start playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8ebb1f14445a595b66c18fae831bb880bc504c92.png[/img]
[h3]"[i]When the [b]Tempest[/b]'s fragments sing, and the [b]Reaper[/b] begins its harvest... what hope remains? May the gods of creation have mercy, for their world teeters on oblivion.[/i]"[/h3]

notes.title: Shards of Her - DEVLog February
notes.content:
Hey there, this will be quite a long read, I think. I hope I don't bore you to [b]Death[/b]

First off, with this update, I'll start making some changes for the full release of the game, including core updates that will be announced and implemented, and so on.

Now, the game will be updated to version 0.4, meaning we're now in ACT 4. I'll slowly update the UI/UX of the game. I’ve already started working on it, but I won’t make it available until I’m sure everything works properly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/7387d2ca73433b48a6effa471c9809fdd947900b.png[/img]

Some things have been moved from where they were before, and a new menu has been introduced where you can find all the in-game lore, including character stories, major locations of importance, items, and more.

By the end of this, I’ll also share a few previews from the next update!

So, let's start by introducing the [b]CODEX Menu[/b], which features several sub-menus, including [b]Characters[/b] (previously moved from the Extra tab), [b]Realms[/b], [b]The Shards[/b], [b]Astrology[/b], and [b]Timeline[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/1046af25da0c9e5cb94a766940a849523e5399e5.png[/img]

For now, these are the main sub-menus available in the [b]CODEX Menu[/b]. Two more are in development, but they will be introduced later, once the Aethral language begins to play a bigger role, its origins and why some beings in the current world still use it.

Plus, [b]Gallery[/b] function is in work.

Now, let's go over the menus and see what we can find there, in the order they appear from left to right

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/5a7e2edea0b4caec8701b3f01405be132df1b642.png[/img]
[h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3]
I'm sure most of you are familiar with this menu, or at least, I hope so, haha. Anyway, it has received an update! Since the cast of characters is growing and new ones are being introduced, I’ve expanded the list. You can now scroll through it or use the mouse to navigate.

Some characters won’t be available right from the start; you’ll need to meet them and interact with them through actions, conversations, or scenes first. Their individual pages have also been updated—for example, [b]Neith[/b]'s page, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/3086bdea41e4775869b17b2ac4ff4b9e64330567.png[/img]

Most character biographies have been updated and improved. In some cases, if the player discovers new information about a specific character, their page will be updated accordingly.

You’ll also notice tags indicating their superpowers, hovering over them will display a short description of each ability.

Additionally, there’s a special row for [b]Origins[/b] and [b]Race[/b]. Origins refers to when or where the character was born, while Race is self-explanatory.

On the right side of the menu, you’ll find [b]Character Variants[/b]. This is where alternate appearances, special outfits, or any other visual differences for a character will be displayed. If a character has another look, you can check it out here. (This is unrelated to the [b]Shadow Realm[/b] content.)

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/90bfd0bdee0823518066784e9e165177dd0ad1d8.png[/img]
[h3][b]Realms[/b][/h3]
Here, you'll find the locations from the game, especially those important to the story and lore. Each location comes with a description, and in some cases, additional lore details about the place.
For now, this feature is limited to viewing locations, but an exploration feature is currently in development.

So, be sure to check them out!

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/82fe192601fc7af0bcc8c94a0c3b6c6bdfeca93d.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Shards[/b][/h3]
The game has always been about the Shards, right? Well, things are finally starting to come together, and this addition was necessary. As you discover Shards, they will appear here, and you’ll be notified via a notification. The first one will be introduced in the next update, so, here we go!

Each Shard’s page will provide details such as its name, origins, a short story, and more. This information will also be updated if the player uncovers new details.

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/546f635307bb305c0e8b39d9f4639455c50ddc84.png[/img]
[h3][b]Astrology[/b][/h3]
This is an early design, but it covers the basics. [b]Astrology[/b] will play a significant role in the game as we progress, which is why you're getting an introduction to it now. At the moment, you can see the months and their corresponding zodiac signs in each box.

For example, [b]Veri Kres[/b] (the equivalent of January) and its zodiac sign, [b]Krathi Neka[/b], are both written in the Aethral Language.

Hovering over the months, will mostly reveal if any of the important characters were born in that month.

More details will be revealed as the game develops!

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/95240ec67e0ae1e58f5f693655217c33f3302c77.png[/img]
[h3][b]Timeline[/b][/h3]
The [b]Timeline[/b] has received some minor adjustments and changes. As you progress through the game and major events occur, they will be added to the timeline. More features will be introduced here, but those will be revealed later.

Now, these are the major changes, aside from dialogue fixes, visual improvements, and other adjustments. Additionally, whenever you discover something new or an entry in the [b]CODEX[/b] is updated, you’ll receive a notification. Meet a new character? Done, you'll get a notification about a new entry in [b]CODEX Characters[/b]. The same applies to other sections.

There are also a few additional things coming in the next update, beyond just story content.

[list]
[*] New Characters
[*] Voice Overs for Narration ([i]the older content is not fully updated yet, will be as the game progress[/i])
[*] Script/Dialogue/Visual Fixes ([i]all over the game[/i])
[*] Story Fixes ([i]there were a few story inconsistencies, which are now fixed[/i])
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Animations
[/list]

Additionally, translation for [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Japanese[/b] has begun! I can't provide an ETA yet, but I'm working on getting it done as soon as possible.

I'm sure I forgot something... I'll probably remember once the post goes live!

Ah, and yes, some SFW previews from the next update, this time from game, I hope you like them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/f1966dcc7747cdd56e2bc7a86e4c0183d9c2ffb7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/b1e9d8193357004482ec041ae0569721de49952e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/4598dc77deb111462b765d0160deb9dd6fe227c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/6cd6d3f292a9ae1f224d242b3b7f5ac03f3fccf3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/35e72d5ea9aca31c7950bce1f543ce67c21b76de.png[/img]

notes.title: Shards of Her 0.3.5 - Update PREVIEW
notes.content:
Hey there! 

I hope all of you are doing great and 2024 is treating you well so far. 

Now, let's get back to business. The next update will advance to version 0.3.5, bringing with it an abundance of new story content and exciting twists for our main character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/3edd2120822b87c8bf26550965e8ffa691d66eed.png[/img]

Along with the story content, the Shadow feature will also receive updates. I noticed a portion of Selena's content was also included; this was an oversight from the Christmas update, which I forgot to remove. 
However, this update is not yet complete. Thus, Selena, Neith, and Mikoto will soon join the rest of the characters in the Shadow.

In this update, the main character will embark on a journey to Egypt, where they will finally meet with Selena and Neith. In this segment of the story, Selena, in particular, will play an important role, significantly influencing the game's direction, in some way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/03db3bafd386559df23fcf6ce190dc9696aceecd.png[/img]

Starting with this update, the '[b]Death[/b]' feature will be made available. It was initially intended to be accessible from ACT2, but will be reintroduced in the final version of the game.

[list]
[*] This implies that occasionally, you'll encounter choices in the game. Typically, there will be a minimum of three options, and one of these could potentially lead to 'Death'. It's as straightforward as that. Credits will roll reflecting your game's progress, and the ending will vary each time. Don't worry, though – you can always reload from your auto-save and select a different option 
[/list]

However, in certain instances, you may receive story-related information or catch glimpses of other worlds. Rest assured, I'll integrate these elements gradually to avoid confusion. 
Therefore, feel free to make your choices boldly; you might be amazed by what you discover, though be aware that some choices could lead to your own demise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/4fd11eff6b31cacd1f23c2bd05457a2461b87a5d.png[/img]

As we progress through ACT 3, a variety of new characters will be introduced. Some will arrive to assist you, while others may appear bearing warnings. It's important to remember: trust is a complex matter in this narrative. Should you trust anyone, or perhaps not?

As the story unfolds, we will delve deeper into the background of our main character, uncovering the unique qualities that makes him 'special'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a3403f6c599ad27e2bfaaa9e77808f71f1800891.png[/img]

I'm trying to avoid revealing too much, as I want to leave the excitement of exploring the next update to you. Unfortunately, I can't provide an ETA for it just yet, but rest assured, I am working on it. As soon as it's ready, I will release it. 
The unexpected delay we encountered has disrupted my schedule somewhat, which is why it's taking me a little longer than usual to compensate and ensure everything is up to standard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a069b367c122cada3a22b1e478c22475ab336035.png[/img]

Also, I've reached a small 'milestone' recently. As of now, ACT 3 has officially surpassed ACT 2 in terms of length, image content, and script lines.

NOTE - [i]I avoided from uploading any NSFW images. However, rest assured, there is a significant amount of NSFW material included in the update.[/i]

Most likely, I forgot to write something...

notes.title: Shards of Her - 0.3.0 ACT III Update & New UI
notes.content:
Hey there, 

Let's roll up with the patch notes for the latest update 0.3.0 and the start of ACT III. 

[b]SOH Patch 0.3.0 Notes[/b]

[h3]Main Game & Additional Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]ACT III RECKONING Intro[/b]
[*] New UI
[/list]

[h3]Fixes/Bugs and UI Issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed some lines where the DEFAULT Name was used instead of the one you choose
[*] Visual Fixes for ACT I & II
[/list]

[h3]Now, let's explore the [b]NEW UI[/b][/h3]

First and foremost, I’ve introduced a new menu to the game. It’s in its final version, though still a work in progress, but the core elements are ready for release.

You might notice the "[b]Gods' Summit[/b]" button. It’s not yet available because this is a significant modification and is taking a bit more time to perfect. My aim is to have it [i]fully playable by or before[/i] the 1.0 release.

Initially, I intended for most of the buttons to be animated, but I’ve encountered some memory issues with RenPy causing significant lag. As a result, for the time being, I’ve opted to use a lite version of the buttons to ensure a smoother user experience.

Upon opening the game, you’ll be greeted with the main menu, from where you can navigate seamlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a425231dfd533bb95ce77e5eda81c61b8ab7d6a9.jpg[/img]

I've added a '[b]Continue[/b]' button for a more seamless experience; it autoloads your most recent saved game, enabling you to instantly resume your journey. There's also the '[b]New Journey[/b]' option to start afresh, and a special addition, '[b]Shards of Her[/b]'.

This new feature allows you to jump directly into a specific ACT of the game. Here’s a glimpse of how the updated menu looks, this feature is slated for further enhancement during the development process. Eventually, you'll be able to jump directly to specific points within a given ACT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/09412cb0eaff2e43783d4ae68d2c125f315d2c6a.jpg[/img]

At present, you can directly access the Prologue, ACT I, ACT II, and ACT III (locked for now). These options are currently unlocked by default, given the game’s Early Access status. However, upon the release of version 1.0, you will need to complete each ACT sequentially to unlock the next one.

Now, turning our attention back to the [b]Extra[/b] menu, a treasury of additional content and features awaits exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a346f58a9fbb8c1b54a9c867d403309f132b17a5.jpg[/img]

At the moment, the options in these menus are already familiar to you. However, keep an eye out as I plan to introduce more features and selections in future updates.

I’ve also revamped the [b]OPTIONS[/b] and [b]LEAVE GAME[/b] menus. They’re currently in a developmental phase, with the OPTIONS menu, in particular, undergoing further refinements to enhance usability and offer a more intuitive interface.

In this update, the spotlight is cast on the unfolding events of the night where ACT II concluded. I’m introducing core basic changes, redesigned UI, and laying down the narrative groundwork for ACT III.

See you soon with more updates!

[olist]
[*] Navigate to "C:/Users/USERNAME/AppData/Roaming/RenPy/ShardsofHer-1669473190"
[*] Copy all the files from this directory.
[*] Paste them to "SteamApps/common/Shards of Her/game/saves"

[/olist]

notes.title: Shards of Her - Update 0.2.0 Notes & News
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

I've been working behind the scenes since the last announcement, preparing for the upcoming patches. First and foremost, we'll kick off with version 0.2.0. This major release marks the beginning of ACT II with its initial segment and sets the groundwork for future events.

For the 0.2.0 update, we're introducing the beginning of ACT II along with some fresh features, such as the Shadow Realm. We'll delve deeper into that below. While it will eventually receive its own dedicated announcement, this is its first release.

[b]The patch should go LIVE in less than 24h by the time you're reading this.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/26add33824585e9c5e30f2b3b9a75ba13b1f7d49.png[/img]

Now, let's start with the notes for 0.2.0 Update. 

Shards of Her 0.2.0 Notes

[list]
[*] [b]ACT II - Echoes[/b] Story Content (Start of ACT II)
[*] SplashScreen updated for ACT II - Echoes
[*] Main Menu UI Updates
[*] Game now starts by default in FULL SCREEN
[*] Launch Teaser can now be skipped by pressing any key
[*] Additional spellcheck fixes and typography for ACT I
[*] UI Updates for Characters Menu 
[*] Characters Menu renamed to "[b]Eternity[/b]"
[*] Timeline was renamed into "[b]Echoes of the Past[/b]"
[*] Music Gallery is now called "[b]The Orchestra[/b]"
[*] Additionally, music from ACT II was added, and now you can change between ACT I and ACT II
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] Shadow Realm (Main Menu > Shadow Realm)
[/list]

That concludes the 0.2.0 Patch details. More updates will follow. This version lays the foundation for me to add additional content for both the Story and the Shadow Realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/e3f209c0175e38a9dca832e83f56ec89f4b18b6e.png[/img]

Now, regarding the Shadow Realm (please note that the UI is very much a work in progress at this stage)

At the moment, Omikami, Nakata, Izanami, and Emma are present in the Shadow Realm. Over time, and as we approach the game's final release, all characters will be included

In this patch, I've included examples of my final design, featuring options to toggle clothes on/off, and various outfits. Some outfits can be discovered in the game and unlocked by meeting specific criteria, while others will be available by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/3492a96571bcb1c8545eb7a9b12e8d0409c7f43f.png[/img]

In the EARLY ACCESS phase, all characters, outfits, and options will be readily available, given the nature of its early release. However, the 1.0 version will have specific conditions applied where appropriate. The requirements to unlock each outfit are detailed under its respective button, but consider these descriptions as placeholders for now.

That said, I'd greatly appreciate your feedback and suggestions for additional features. The version for Omikami serves as the [i]complete[/i] prototype. By "complete," I mean this is the ideal template for all characters in the final product. Each outfit will come with an in/out animation for a close-up view, plus added options where feasible. For instance, in a close-up view of a character's upper body wearing a simple t-shirt, you'd have the option to toggle it on or off.

More outfits and options will be added as the game gradually updates. 

Now, let's return to the main content of the game. In the 0.2.0 update, we kick off ACT II, which will introduce some intriguing events and sensual scenes. 

Later, as the game updates, we'll delve deeper into Emma's background: who designed her, the objectives of her company, and more. While we'll spend a significant amount of time with Nakata, Izanami will only make a comeback towards the end of the ACT. However, in the interim, we'll grow closer to Omikami and encounter some new characters.

So far, my schedule for this version goes like this (keep in mind that it's possible to get a 2 in 1 patch)
[list]
[*] [b]Patch 0.2.0[/b] - Base update for ACT II 
[*] [b]Patch 0.2.3[/b] - Main Story Content
[*] [b]Patch 0.2.6[/b] - Main Story Content along with some new characters
[*] [b]Patch 0.2.9[/b] - Closure for ACT II Story 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/1013e2daccecde429fcd1ec815ac6d2e3d8a48a2.png[/img]

These are the primary and most crucial updates slated for version 0.2. Between these, there might be other patches, hotfixes if needed, and added content for the Shadow Realm if it's not included in the main patch.

As always, please share your feedback either here or in the Discussions section. As you can see, I always read them and respond.

The main store page will be updated soon to reflect some of the changes that occurred in this patch.

notes.title: Shards of Her - Patch 0.1.7 & News
notes.content:
Hey there,

Let's begin with the notes for the latest patch, then we continue with some news! 

SOH Patch 0.1.7 Notes

[list]
[*] ADDED Izanami into the CHARACTERS Showcase.
[*] ADDED MUSIC ROOM which can be accessed from Main Menu (for ACT 1).
[*] Script and spellcheck fixes.
[*] Preparation made for the release of ACT 2.
[*] Fixed an updated version of AME-MIKOTO not showing up in CHARACTERS.
[*] Adjustments to TIMELINE Menu (added "BACK" button, previously you had to ESC or RightClick to Exit).
[*] Default Volume raised up to 0.60 (Before the default was at 0.40, this does not overwrite your own settings).
[*] Improvements made to the CHARACTERS Showcase. 
[*] UI changes to the Quit Menu.
[/list]

As always, please let me know if there are any issues and suggestions are welcomed! 

Now, let's head to some other features that will come in Shards of Her, as additional content for the game and for you. This feature will soon get its own announcement, since it'll be pretty big, and I will share more info then. But, for now, a short summary and what to expect! 

The new feature, or content that will be added it's called [b]God's Summit[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/961d4fd21ed17184d26607766df16d1ce1e9377e.png[/img]

[h3][b]What's God's Summit?[/b] [/h3]
A new feature which will be available at some time, and you directly access it from the Main Menu of the game, this does not affect nor affected by the main game story and the choices you did. 

[h3][b]So, what can I actually do there?[/b][/h3]
Talk with the characters you meet along your journey, some may join, some may not! Not everyone is welcomed in the God's Summit, but eventually we'll get there too!

Yes, you can talk with them, but there are other things you can do, like invite one or two of them to some private moments.

So yeah, overall, talk and initiate intimate moments with whatever characters are present at that time in the God's Summit. 

[h3][b]Which characters will be available?[/b][/h3]
In time yes, at the first release not all of them will be present there, but gradually I'll add most of them. Since it's custom content, there's no limit to what you can do and with whom you want. 

[h3][b]Is there a release date?[/b][/h3]
There's no ETA yet, I'm working on it, and I'll probably have a release date for it once the announcement is published, which is not that far away. Please keep in mind that not all characters will be present at the time of first release. 


[h3]And now, something about the [b]CHARACTERS Showcase[/b][/h3]

At the moment it seems pretty basic, with characters biography and how they look, but in the feature and along with some other updates this will receive its own updates too. 

Some points or features that will come in the Showcase Menu sooner or later. 
[list]
[*] The featured image of the character will be based on the relationship you have with that character (an ex. if you have a good relationship with Omikami, you'll get a more revealing image of her in the Showcase).
[*] Different takes, positions and clothes for the Characters (a button will be added for each one of them, taking you into some other dimension where you can play around).
[/list]
